translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: LUGU
book.title: Lugu Luguhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Bi yobage lowa nogo sibi mbira pu ereba hene lenego ogo
Horo mbirungi dagisi muni miagarubi ko biaga marubi Yasuhanda bi layago hale hole ibiyagola
Perisi agalibi Mana lowinigo lawai hagabi hearume bi gimigomo lalu, Agali ogome mana ko ngubi biaga karuhondo, Hami̱ya, lagabi ti heba tomo nalu biragabi ka, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ti bi yobage ogo lamini.
Tí mbirame nogo sibi handari mbira (100) hinuwa mbirago pu ereba hayagua ibu agi bulebirabe. Ibugua pira dirani dira (99) tani nalu helalu pu ereba hayago tai bima ibaga bialu handa walia haga.
Handa walia howa ibu turu tara haga. Ani buwa ibuni payani yalu

andaga dai biaga. Dai buwa ibu nenegerubi ibula handa a̱i̱ na̱i̱ padarubi mandagi olo ngoai howa lalu, I̱naga nogo sibi mbira pu ereba hayago handa walia harugo ai turu taraore ho kogo ina haru turu ho hama, lolebira.

Ogonidagua dege bulebiragonaga i̱na tí langerogo wali agali pira dirani dira (99) bayale howa mini beregedolene nawi karunaga ndo mbira koore biaga henego mini beregedalu dai biyagonaga dahuliya andagani turu taraore holene wulebira, lene.
Bi yobage lowa muni ereba hene te lenego ogo

Ani lowa Yasuhanda lalu, Wali mbirame muni kuni pira winiru pinigo ereba hayagua ibugua agi bulebirabe. Ibugua lamu hale hedo yuwa tai bialu handa waliaore hole lowa durumbu hilo ba tagi howa baya hangu tai biame haga.
Ibugua handa walia howa ibu nenegerubi ibula handa a̱i̱ na̱i̱ padarubi olowa lalu, Muni kuni mbira ereba hayago handa walia harugo ai mandagi turu ho hami̱ya ibidaba, lolebira.
Ogonidagua dege i̱na tí langerogo mbira koore biaga henego mini beregedalu dai biyagua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga dahuliyalirume turu taraore holebira, lene.
Bi yobage lowa igiri pu ereba hene lenego ogo
Yasuhanda la ho wiaabo howa lalu, Agali mbira ibu igini kira hene.

Ani howa igiri heyogonegome ibu abahondo lalu, Aba-o munibi mbirale marubi i̱ ngule wiridago tale bialu áyu ogoni ngi, lene. Ani layagola agali biagome ibunaga mbirale wiyaruni ibu igini biago labohondo mo tale bia hene.

Ani buwa horo kiru tebiru agima howa igiri heyogone biagome ibunaga mbirale yayaruni yolo miai halu muni hangu yalu ibu andaga wahalu pene. Dindi kaundiaoreha pu howa ibuninaga mini bayuwa haru nahe howa muni yayago ko galone nabulene wiaru hanguni mohole bialu hene.
Ani buwa mbirale yayaruni bibahendeore biba hai hene. Ani bu hearia dindi ogoniha hina gari timbuniore piyagola igiri biago ibu mbirale mbira nayiore hene.
Ani biyagola agali mbira heagome ibunaga mabuha, Nogo haru hole pu, layagola nogo haru ha hole pene.
Haru hearia mbirame ibuhondo tomo emeneore namiyagola garibi timbuni lowa tomo hingilu wahayago noa timbuni ho hene.
Ani buwa mani mini wia dai bialu lalu, I̱ abanaga biabe bia haga karume tomo timbuni nalu maru nabe manga ho kago i̱ nde ogoria nane howa tongolo mibeheore kogoni.
I̱na áyu ogoni heyalu i̱ aba kagoria puwa ibuhondo lalu, Aba-o i̱na Ngode Datagaliwabehondobi í̠hondobi ko bialu hoba mu harugoni.
Ai áyu i̱na í̠ igini labe nahe kogoni. Í̠naga biabe bia haga karuhondo bialu harilidagua i̱hondobi bialu habe lolebero.

Ani mitangi bialu ibu aba hearia pole heyalu andaga dai bini.... ibu abahanda hondowa ibunaga bu miniha daraore ho howa abale gerai puwa yu hurubale buwa nu̱nu̱ lene. Ibu andagani anda íbu nabi wene amuraore ibalu hearia ibu abahanda hondowa ibunaga bu miniha daraore ho howa abale gerai puwa yu hurubale buwa yu nu̱nu̱ lene.
Ani biyagola ibu igini biagome lalu, Aba-o i̱na Ngode Datagaliwabehondobi í̠hondobi hoba mu howa koore birugo ndobe. Ai i̱na í̠ igini labe nahe kogoni, lene.
Ani layagola ibu abahanda ibunaga biabe bia haga biaru, Ibai hadaba, lowa, Aga bayaleore abale mo puwa gi hondoneni magibi karula halu ge su mo karula halu bidaba.
Ani bialu nogo bulumaga igini habahe mbira kago bo puwa dawadaba. Ani buwa turu halu nami̱ya.
I̱ igini ogoni homayago ai dére ho kagoni. Pu ereba hayago ai handa walia kogoni, lene. Ani layagola howa ti tomo biagoni dawalu hene.

Ani bialu hea tambu igiri wahene biago mabuha biabe bialu hene. Ibugua andaga kaware dai bialu howa hale halu hearia amu andaga biagoha mbira bi anda howa iba ganaru lalu mali lialu hayuane hale hene.
Ani biayuagola biabe bia haga mbira heago olowa hale halu lalu, O biaruagoni agi birabe, lene.

Biabe bia haga biagome ladai bialu lalu, Í̠ hamene biago andaga íbu dai biyagola í̠ abahanda ibu igini biago homo ereba nahe heneda lowa nogo bulumaga igini habahe mbira heago bo dawalu ka, lalu lamini.
Ani layagola hale howa igiri wahene biagome kera gibiore howa andaga anda pu nabi hene. Ani biyagola ibu abahanda abale tagira puwa yu hurubale buwa, Andaga mba, lene.

Ani layagola ibu abahondo lalu, I̱na mali bibahende biagoni í̠na bi larigo mbira mo wa nahe garabaya biabe ale biaabo halu harugoni. Í̠na i̱ agile ngiribe. I̱ nenege karu baba nogo memebi mbira bo dawaliya nangiriligo manda berene.
Í̠ igini ogoni í̠naga mbirale wiriru mohole bialu walime kayu bibiya ngi layagola mialu andaga íbu dai biyagola nogo bulumaga igini habahe mbira heago ba harida, lene.
Ani layagola ibu abahanda lalu, I̱ igini-o í̠ horo bibahendengi i̱la haabo howa mbirale i̱na wu hewaru í̠naga ho haribagoni.
Anigo áyu nogo balu uru halu kamago nde í̠ hamene biago homayago dére halu pu ereba hayago handa walia halu birimagonaga beramagoni, lene, lalu Yasuhanda lamini.
